name: Knowledge and RAG Accelerator Solution Pack
description: A commercial solution pack for producing governed knowledge bases and grounded retrieval experiences with provenance, citations, access controls, evaluation, refresh, and migration support.
business_outcome: Give authorized users fast, grounded access to current knowledge while reducing unsupported answers, access leakage, stale guidance, and untraceable claims.
implementation_model: A gated engagement covering source authorization, extraction, knowledge modeling, retrieval and RAG design, adversarial and quality evaluation, governance approval, controlled release, refresh, and migration.
success_measures: retrieved evidence is relevant and authorized
answers are grounded and correctly cited
no-answer and conflict behavior is reliable
stale and revoked content is detected
owners can correct, refresh, audit, and migrate the corpus
support_model: AI AuthoriTech provides knowledge architecture, ingestion planning, retrieval evaluation, governance, platform adaptation, monitoring, refresh operations, and separately authorized migration support.
